propositions: CloudWatch alarms voter_errors and replication_errors declare no alarm_actions or ok_actions, so metric transitions from OK to ALARM fire silently with no SNS notification despite being the only two alarms in the repo with this defect.

Eleven of thirteen aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm blocks in infra/terraform establish the repo convention of wiring both alarm_actions and ok_actions to aws_sns_topic.alerts.arn; the two silent alarms are configuration omissions, not intended behavior.

A regression guard test must parse every aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm block under infra/terraform, fail on any lacking alarm_actions, carry an anti-vacuity assertion (>= 13 blocks parsed), and require explicit documented opt-out markers for intentionally silent alarms.
Merging HCL to main does not apply terraform to AWS, so wiring the SNS actions in code leaves the alarms still notifying nobody until an operator runs terraform apply.

The voter_errors alarm gates Bedrock cutover safety validation under ADR-0013; the alarm chain publishes correctly but the notification target was missing, creating a silent failure path discoverable only by active console monitoring.
